substrate_ms_id: sample_id of the maize silage used as rumen incubation substrate
substrate_ms_mg: amount of maize silage (mg) added for rumen incubation substrate (exact)
substrate_gs_id: sample_id of the grass silage used as rumen incubation substrate
substrate_gs_mg: amount of grass silage (mg) added for rumen incubation substrate (exact)
substrate_conc_id: sample_id of the concentrate used as rumen incubation substrate
substrate_conc_mg: amount of concentrate (mg) added for rumen incubation substrate (exact)
substrate_straw_id: sample_id of the straw used as rumen incubation substrate
substrate_straw_mg: amount of straw (mg) added for rumen incubation substrate (exact)
masterfile_id: id of the masterfile (experiment) the data belong to, e.g. KLM26_05
substrate_id: sample_id of the substrate; the 'variable' column in the mother file indicates the substrate variable it belongs to
substrate_sbm_id: sample_id of the soybean meal used as rumen incubation substrate
substrate_conc_mixture_id: id of the concentrate mixture used as rumen incubation substrate (composition described by compound_1, compound_2, ...)
compound_1: sample_id of the first compound of a substrate mixture
info_compound_1: additional information on the first compound of a substrate mixture
compound_1_g_per_kg_dm: amount of the first compound in the substrate mixture (g per kg dry matter)
compound_2: sample_id of the second compound of a substrate mixture
info_compound_2: additional information on the second compound of a substrate mixture
compound_2_g_per_kg_dm: amount of the second compound in the substrate mixture (g per kg dry matter)
inocula_id: id of the inoculum collected, used for tracing extra inoculum characteristics in motherfile
inocula_date: date of the inoculum collection, format <dd/mm/yyyy>
inocula_name: name of the individual or pooled inoculum
cow_ilvo_id: ILVO id of the cow the inoculum was collected from
diet_cows: diet (feed composition) of the cows the inocula were collected from
trt_label_1: a custom label for treatment which can be used for the statistical analysis, e.g. high starch
trt_label_2: a custom label for treatment which can be used for the statistical analysis, e.g. high starch
trt_label_3: a custom label for treatment which can be used for the statistical analysis, e.g. high starch
trt_rep_1_type: treatment replacement type (treatment which replaces a certain amount of substrate)
trt_rep_1_id: treatment replacement id (treatment which replaces a certain amount of substrate)
nylon_pore_size_um: pore size of the nylon bag (micro meter)
bag_size_cm2: surface area of the nylon bag (cm2)
trt_add_1_id: id of treatment additive 1 (links to the trt_add sheet in the mother file)
trt_add_1_ug_per_ml: concentration of treatment additive 1 in the incubation (ug per ml)
trt_add_2_id: id of treatment additive 2 (links to the trt_add sheet in the mother file)
trt_add_2_ug_per_ml: concentration of treatment additive 2 in the incubation (ug per ml)
trt_add_3_id: id of treatment additive 3 (links to the trt_add sheet in the mother file)
trt_add_3_ug_per_ml: concentration of treatment additive 3 in the incubation (ug per ml)
trt_add_4_id: id of treatment additive 4 (links to the trt_add sheet in the mother file)
trt_add_4_ug_per_ml: concentration of treatment additive 4 in the incubation (ug per ml)
post_rumen_stomach_duration: duration of the post-rumen stomach (abomasum) incubation
post_rumen_small_intestine_duration: duration of the post-rumen small intestine incubation
ph_b_rf: pH of the buffer and rumen fluid mixture
methane_umol_per_g_dm: methane production (umol per g dry matter)
hydrogen_umol_per_g_dm: hydrogen production (umol per g dry matter)
total_vfa_umol_per_g_dm: total volatile fatty acid production (umol per g dry matter)
methane_total_vfa_mol_per_mol: methane to total volatile fatty acids ratio (mol per mol)
acetate_umol_per_g_dm: acetate production (umol per g dry matter)
propionate_umol_per_g_dm: propionate production (umol per g dry matter)
isobutyrate_umol_per_g_dm: isobutyrate production (umol per g dry matter)
butyrate_umol_per_g_dm: butyrate production (umol per g dry matter)
isovalerate_umol_per_g_dm: isovalerate production (umol per g dry matter)
valerate_umol_per_g_dm: valerate production (umol per g dry matter)
caproate_umol_per_g_dm: caproate production (umol per g dry matter)
acetate_percent: proportion of acetate in the total volatile fatty acids (percent)
propionate_percent: proportion of propionate in the total volatile fatty acids (percent)
isobutyrate_percent: proportion of isobutyrate in the total volatile fatty acids (percent)
butyrate_percent: proportion of butyrate in the total volatile fatty acids (percent)
isovalerate_percent: proportion of isovalerate in the total volatile fatty acids (percent)
valerate_percent: proportion of valerate in the total volatile fatty acids (percent)
caproate_percent: proportion of caproate in the total volatile fatty acids (percent)
rumen_degradability_percent: dry matter degradability in the rumen incubation (percent)
overall_degradability_percent: overall dry matter degradability (rumen and post-rumen) (percent)
methane_umol_per_g_dm_digested: methane production (umol per g digested dry matter)
postrumen_digestibility_percent: dry matter digestibility in the post-rumen incubation (percent)
septum: colour of the septum of the flask
